lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
shiftsnext-mainApp: 8 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
All 2 pages load the same 2 files: 1,014,481 B raw, 266,805 B gzip, 99.2 % of the smallest page (shiftsnext-mainAdminSettings, 1,022,647 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/dialogs 297,633 B, @nextcloud/vue 242,662 B, axios 59,272 B, temporal-polyfill 58,955 B, @vue/runtime-core 49,740 B.
9 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (108 packages, 476 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
